title: Group CD2 — substantive original-content research batch 001 (first five candidates)
methodology: Read accessible original country/city/detail pages, extract their actual content, follow map and related links, inspect independent geographic evidence and dated reports; document failures without inferring absent evidence.
research_integrity: These five received substantive source investigation; only one (209) obtained its original listing coordinates. For four others, the actual original detail body remains inaccessible, so their source research is still incomplete. This is NOT five 'fully completed' candidates.

The source names Břidličná street and a visitor describes approaching via Podolská and U Vápenné skály. One firsthand comment from May 2023 reports daytime warm-season use of the wooded slopes and higher rocks. A June 2026 comment asks about meeting there but does not confirm an encounter. The original map directions place the claimed site at 50.0517654419, 14.419169426. Take care around steep rocky ground and follow any site restrictions.
